literature.scope: Best reported mean within each cited table, not an exhaustive state-of-the-art leaderboard. Ties use published rounded means. No scores imputed for missing tasks.
literature.metric: MMER: maximum over training epochs of mean episodic return, then mean and SD across training seeds. Original episodic-return scale, not min-max standardized chart scores.
literature.aliases: StatelessCartPole -> PositionOnlyCartPole; NoisyStatelessCartPole -> NoisyPositionOnlyCartPole. Historical task correspondence only, not proof of identical versions/dynamics. VelocityOnlyCartpole is not an alias.

popgym.label: POPGym · PPO
popgym.citation: Morad et al., ICLR 2023, Appendix B, Table 3
popgym.protocol: RLlib PPO; 15M training steps (DNC 10M); 3 trials; best-during-training MMER; reported SD. Best among 13 models per task.

popjym.label: JAX · PPO
popjym.citation: Lu et al., NeurIPS 2023, Appendix C, Table 5 (JAX rows only)
popjym.variant: Paper's JAX POPGym reimplementation; not verified identical to our pinned/audited POPJym ports
popjym.protocol: JAX PPO; paper uses original benchmark timesteps (15M); 8 seeds; best-during-training MMER; reported SD. Best among S5, GRU and MLP JAX rows only; excludes copied Morad rows and continuous Pendulum tasks.

weekend-lambda.label: Weekend suite · SAC+λ
weekend-lambda.protocol: Our earlier suite (Oct): 250k steps + prefill, GRU512, MLP512 heads, α=.1, λ2=.85, β=.1 (λ only), FE LR 1e-5, windowed replay (burn-in 10/seq 40). Final = 100 holdout episodes; best = max over 25k evaluations (20 episodes). Many tasks have only 1 completed seed (queue stopped).
